notes.title: LumineNight Emergency Bug Update Notice
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the LumineNight development team.
We have confirmed a critical bug after the latest update that makes it impossible to progress in the game.[/p][p]The issue occurs in [i]Mary’s Trial – Bookstore Puzzle[/i], where the game cannot be played normally. Specifically, when adjusting the position of the notes with the mouse, the note’s shape changes, causing the puzzle to become impossible to clear.[/p][p]As a temporary workaround, the puzzle can still be cleared if you use a keyboard or gamepad instead of the mouse.[/p][p]This bug is scheduled to be fixed within today.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p]For other bug reports or inquiries related to the game, please contact us at [url="https://spickasoft@gmail.com"]spickasoft@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: LumineNight Global Update Celebration – 30% Discount!
notes.content:
Hello, Detectives!
This is the LumineNight development team.
We're excited to announce that Lumine Night now supports multiple global languages and several major bugs have been fixed.
To celebrate this milestone, a 30% discount will be available for two weeks!

Sale Period:
From April 9, 10:00 AM (GMT+9) to April 23, 10:00 AM (GMT+9)

Thank you for your continued support!

tags.bug: several major bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: LumineNight 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]1.1.0g Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dialogue volume could not be adjusted in certain situations.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0f Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dialogues were displayed incorrectly at certain resolution ratios.
[*] Adjusted the main screen and chapter selection screen to adapt based on the resolution.
[*] Fixed a typo in the date text when entering a specific map.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0e Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Rearranged objects and hitboxes in a specific late-game map to make investigation targets clearer.
[*] Fixed an issue where keyboard controls would malfunction after manipulating certain UI elements in the settings with the mouse.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0d Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where progression became impossible in the hotel lobby map.
[*] Unified the control guide to show keyboard controls when using keyboard and mouse.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0c Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Some credit information has been changed.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0b Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Korean and English were incorrectly linked in the language settings during the first launch.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0a Hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the close button disappeared on the chapter selection screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the beach map background texture was broken.
[/list]

[b]1.1.0 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Language Support[/b]
The following language data has been added:
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]
Some UI text sizes have been adjusted.
The English font has been changed.

[b]Gamepad Support[/b]
[list]
[*] When using a gamepad, control guide icons will now match the corresponding controller.
[*] Added support for DualSense and DualShock 4.
[*] Steam Input is now supported.
[/list]

[b]Game Resources[/b]
[list]
[strike][*] Unused margins in game data files have been removed.
[*] The installation size has been reduced to within 4GB; however, update downloads will now be significantly larger.[/strike]
[*] Background and UI textures have been optimized for FHD resolution.
[*] Additional SFX has been added.
[/list]
[b]Game Save Data[/b]
[list]
[*] The save file location has changed:
[list]
[*] Previous: %localappdata%\Case101
[*] New: %localappdata%\LumineNight[/list]
[*] Upon launching the game for the first time after the update, existing save files will be moved to the new directory.
[*] Steam Cloud Save is now supported.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Miscellaneous Changes[/b]

[b]Demo Version Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The demo version has been updated to reflect the changes in Version 1.1.0 of the full game.
[*] Map Exploration and Stealth Mode have been removed.
[*] Players who wish to play the previous version of the demo can do so by switching branches in the [Settings] menu.
[*] Save data can now be carried over to the full game. If you purchase the full version after completing the demo, you can continue playing from where you left off.
[/list]

Due to the scale of this update, there may be unexpected bugs, particularly regarding language support and translations.
If you encounter any issues, please report them on the Steam Community forums. Your feedback will help us improve the game and provide better service.
Thank you.

notes.title: Notice about known issues in LumineNight
notes.content:
Hello,

As of December 3, 2024, we would like to provide an update regarding known bugs in the game Luminanite.

The currently identified bugs are as follows:

- Keyboard input not functioning properly in certain UI elements.
[strike]- White objects appearing outside the mansion.[/strike](solved)
- UI character resources breaking in low-spec mode.
[strike]- Dialogue log content becoming corrupted during infiltration.[/strike](solved)
- Some texts not localized into english, showing korean.
- Getting stuck while reading diary.
- Getting stuck after using contemplate

We are actively working to resolve these issues as quickly as possible.
And is currently adding on more autosave checkpoint which will be ready within first week of December.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

Thank you.
